items.title: Volkswagen Taigun sells 100,000 units in India and 52,751 overseas since launch
items.summary: The Volkswagen Taigun, which turned five years old last month after its launch in September 2021 , has surpassed the 100,000-units domestic market sales milestone. As per SIAM wholesales numbers, the midsize SUV has sold 99,095 units till end-September 2026.

items.title: Tata Altroz Drives Past 350,000 Sales, Contributes 34% to Tata Car Sales Since Launch
items.summary: The Tata Altroz has surpassed the 350,000-unit wholesales milestone in the Indian market. As per SIAM wholesales data, Tata Motors’ premium hatchback had clocked total sales of 349,185 units till the end of September 2026.

items.title: New Sorento Midsize SUV Sells 1,739 Units in First Month, Kia India Sales Grow 29% in H1 FY2027
items.summary: The new Kia Sorento midsize SUV, launched on September 4, has sold 1,739 units in its first full month of wholesales (factory dispatches) in the domestic market. Kia India’s new ICE-powered flagship SUV, which was the fifth highest-selling model for the company last month, contributed 5% to Kia India’s record monthly sales in September.

items.title: Vinfast India sells 14,600 EVs since market entry 14 months ago
items.summary: Vinfast Auto India, the local arm of the Vietnamese electric vehicle major VinFast, has delivered 14,637 zero-emission passenger vehicles to customers since its market launch on September 6, 2025 through to October 14, 2026. As per Vahan, this gives the company a 4% share of the 343,876 e-PVs bought in the past 13-and-a-half months.

items.title: Motorcycle OEMs clock second-highest H1 sales of 6.92 million, Hero and Honda up 12%, Bajaj down 7%
items.summary: The motorcycle segment, the largest two-wheeler sub-segment in India, has registered its second highest first-half wholesales in April-September 2026. The 6.92 million units, up 10% YoY (H1 FY2026: 6.27 million units) are now the next best after the record 7.37 million motorcycles sold in H1 FY2019.

items.title: High-Tech Two-Wheelers Power EV Revenue Surge at Auto Parts Supplier Sona
items.summary: Advanced driver-assistance hardware once restricted to high-end automobiles is officially making its way onto everyday scooters and motorcycles, signaling a major technology shift across the personal mobility sector. Leading automotive supplier Sona secured an Rs 100 crore order for rear radar sensors designed specifically for two-wheelers during the second quarter.

items.title: Q2 surge powers electric car, SUV sales past 192,000 units in first-half FY2027
items.summary: India’s electric vehicle growth story is really charged up this year. After the first six months of FY2027, total retail sales of 18,10,163 million EVs across the e-2W, e-3W, e-passenger and e-commercial vehicle segments have risen 60% YoY (H1 FY2025: 11,34,054 units) and are already 71% of FY2026’s record 2.54 million EVs.

items.title: Record 207,850 e-2W sales in September power H1 FY027’s 1.12 million units
items.summary: With the sixth month of the current fiscal and a record one at that, it’s amply clear that India’s electric 2-wheeler industry is on a roll and how. While January-September 2026 retail sales have already crossed 1.61 million units, e-2W customer deliveries in the April-September period jumped 76% to 1.12 million units (H1 FY2026: 640,149 units).

items.title: TVS NTorq Surpasses 2.5 Million Sales, Last 500,000 Units Sold in 15 Months
items.summary: TVS Motor Co, which continues to ride a surging wave of demand for its scooters, both ICE and electrc, is benefiting from the sustained growth delivered by its second best-selling model, the NTorq. Launched on February 5, 2018, the NTorq 125 had sold 2.08 million units till end-August 2025.

items.title: Tata Motors CV sales cross 200,000 units in H1 FY2027, industry sales grow 24% on strong demand
items.summary: The Indian commercial vehicle industry is in good nick this fiscal. With wholesales of 574,255 units in April-September 2026, the 17 OEMs have registered strong 24% YoY growth (H1 FY2026: 464,023 units).

items.title: Tractor Industry Faces H2 Reality Check as Wholesale Dispatches Fall 18%
items.summary: Tractor makers are entering the festive season after a monsoon that ended about 13 percent below normal, according to India Meteorological Department (IMD) data. Concerns about a strong El Niño raise the risk of further pressure on rural demand.

items.title: Bajaj Auto 2W, 3W and Qute exports jump 50% in April-August to 1.26 million units
items.summary: Despite the turbulent geopolitical scenario, demand for made-in-India vehicles continues to be on the upswing. As per the latest export sales numbers released by SIAM, automobile exports across the passenger vehicle, 2-wheeler, 3-wheeler and quadricycle segments increased by 29.6% to 3.28 million units in April-August 2026.

items.title: Maruti Suzuki’s SUV, MPV share of PV sales at 42% in H1 FY2027 with 455,692 units
items.summary: Passenger vehicle market leader Maruti Suzuki India has crossed the 1-million wholesales mark for the first time in the first-half of a fiscal in April-September 2026. The 10,80,240 units are a handsome 36% YoY increase and the result of a revival in demand for its cars and sedans following GST 2.0 price reductions and, importantly, the big jump in sales of its utility vehicles comprising SUVs and MPVs.
